units: <cite ref="Shabbat 9b:6">Sabb. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>הַתְחָלַת התספורת</he> the preparations for hair-cutting.—
Ex. R. s. 1 אין ויואל אלא לשון ה׳ vayoël (Ex. II, 21) has the meaning of beginning (attempting).

<cite ref="Berakhot 14b:6">Ber. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>הויא ה׳</he> is considered a beginning of the recitation (and you must finish it); a. fr.—Pl. <he>הַתְחָלוֹת</he>. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 2 <he>כל ה׳ קשות</he> all beginnings are difficult. Cmp. <cite ref="A03413"><he>אַתְחַלְתָּא</he></cite>.
